away.name: Carter Hart
away.news: Hart led the Golden Knights onto the ice for warmups.

home.name: Jeremy Swayman
home.news: The Bruins lead the Atlantic Division with a 10-4-1 record, largely thanks to Jeremy Swayman's stellar play. That said, Swayman is coming off his worst performance of this season, allowing four goals on 18 shots (.778 SV%) in a 4-1 loss to the St. Louis Blues. The 27-year-old American goalie has a 2.35 GAA and .912 SV% in 11 games this season (7-3-1). The Bruins enter Monday's outing as slight +104 home underdogs against a Vegas Golden Knights team that has scored two or fewer goals in four of their last five games (1-3-1).

away.name: Daniil Tarasov
away.news: Last season, Tarasov posted a 3.05 GAA and .895 SV% in 33 games (13-15-3) with the Florida Panthers, and he will face his former team for the first time since joining the Red Wings. The 27-year-old Russian goalie has been used sparingly this season, but has been solid when called upon, posting a 1.40 GAA and .940 SV% in four appearances (1-0-2). The Red Wings enter Monday's outing as +155 road underdogs against a Panthers team on a three-game winning streak.

home.name: Jacob Markstrom
home.news: Markstrom has missed over two weeks due to an upper-body injury but will return to the crease on Monday against the Detroit Red Wings. The 36-year-old Swedish goalie has been serviceable early in his Panthers tenure, posting a 3-1-1 record, but has been lightly tested most nights, resulting in a pedestrian .897 SV% and a 2.21 GAA. The Panthers enter Monday's contest as -171 home favourites against a Red Wings team that has scored four or more goals in five of their last seven games (4-2-1).

away.name: Mackenzie Blackwood
away.news: Colorado Head Coach Jared Bednar has favoured Mackenzie Blackwood early in the 2026-27 season and will continue rolling with him on Monday against the Chicago Blackhawks. The 29-year-old Blackwood saved 25 of 27 shots (.926 SV%) in his most recent game, a 5-2 win over the Calgary Flames. Blackwood has allowed three or fewer goals in six straight games (5-1-0), posting a 2.35 GAA and .915 SV%. The Avalanche enter the action as significant -222 road favourites.

home.name: Spencer Knight
home.news: After a promising inaugural full season with the Blackhawks in 2025-26, posting a 2.82 GAA and .902 SV% in 55 games (19-25-11), Knight has had an inconsistent start to 2026-27. That said, he has strung together a few good outings, posting a 2.37 GAA and .922 SV% in his last three games (1-2-0). The 25-year-old American goalie has a 3.21 GAA and .897 SV% in 11 games this season (4-7-0). The Blackhawks enter Monday's game as sizeable +192 home underdogs against a Colorado Avalanche team that has scored five or more goals in three of their last four games (3-1-0).

away.name: Dustin Wolf
away.news: Dustin Wolf's unencouraging play to start the 2026-27 season led the team to rely on Devin Cooley, who started five straight games toward the end of October. That said, Cooley's injury gave Wolf a chance to make his mark between the pipes, and he did in his most recent outing, saving 20 of 22 shots (.909 SV%) in a 6-2 win over the Seattle Kraken. The 25-year-old Wolf has an ugly 4.39 GAA and .847 SV% in seven appearances (2-4-0) this season. The Flames enter Monday's game as slight +109 road underdogs against a San Jose Sharks team that has scored only four goals combined in its past three games (1-2-0).

home.name: Yaroslav Askarov
home.news: The Sharks have lost three of their last four (1-3-0), but have received solid goaltending from Askarov in recent games. Askarov started the season with a dreadful 4.00 GAA and .848 SV% in his first five games (2-3-0), but has an impressive 1.76 GAA and .950 SV% in his last four (2-2-0). The Sharks enter Monday's action as -120 home favourites against a Calgary Flames team that has scored two or fewer goals in two of their last three games (1-2-0).
